findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_games, list_updates, edit_update, list_comments, lock_comments, mark_comments_read · Private data: upload_media, list_builds, playtest_link, post_update, edit_update · Public sink: where_to_publish, upload_media, upload_web_build, submit_game, update_game, define_trophy, define_board, playtest_link, post_update, edit_update, pin_update, delete_update, list_comments, mark_comments_read · Destructive: playtest_link, delete_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_games, list_updates, edit_update, list_comments, lock_comments, mark_comments_read · Private data: upload_media, list_builds, playtest_link, post_update, edit_update · Public sink: where_to_publish, upload_media, upload_web_build, submit_game, update_game, define_trophy, define_board, playtest_link, post_update, edit_update, pin_update, delete_update, list_comments, mark_comments_read · Destructive: playtest_link, delete_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
